focus: Over-engineering census of system-deep-loop: divergent pivot, legacy projections + watermark, idea lifecycle, dual telemetry, wave planner, if_cli_copilot; count production callers and name what breaks on removal
answeredQuestions: Over-engineering: which system-deep-loop runtime surfaces (divergent pivot, legacy projection, idea lifecycle, observability, wave planner) have no live caller or test, and what would break if each were removed?

label: if_cli_copilot branches are unreachable: 3 sites (deep-review-confirm.yaml:1317, deep-research-confirm.yaml:1190, deep-review-auto.yaml:1239) but 'copilot' is absent from EXECUTOR_KINDS (executor-config.ts:11-21) and rejected by z.enum at :82; no cli-copilot skill dir exists. Removing them breaks nothing. deep-research-auto.yaml lacks the branch, indicating copy-drift.

runtime/lib/branch-leases-waves is dark: 3117 LOC, zero production importers outside its own dir; only erased type-only imports (conditional-fanin/types.ts:19, substrate-ports.ts:10) and a port field substrate-ports.ts:72 with no implementer. Introduced c8943e4d9f 2026-07-21 labelled 'dark (036/009)'. Removing it breaks no production path; the dangling port field must drop with it.

reference_only_appendix (deep-research-auto.yaml:2483 + 3 more assets) has zero code readers across .cjs/.ts/.mjs; its wave_orchestration.summary is prose nothing executes. Removing it removes only advisory text.

Two telemetry streams per run: orchestration-status.log (declared deep-research-auto.yaml:152, written fanout-run.cjs:3364) is a strict subset of observability-events.jsonl (fanout-run.cjs:519, status.cjs:34, convergence.cjs:41, round-state-jsonl.cjs:22). Every log fact is derivable from the JSONL payload; no production reader of the .log was found. P2 not P1 because operator habit may be the consumer.

Idea lifecycle is three-way inconsistent: reducer maps idea_observed/promoted/rejected/_removed/_reset to Object.freeze([]) no-ops (deep-research-reducer.ts:151-158, rationale at :154); the auto variant runs rejected-pattern suppression (deep-research-auto.yaml:1068, :1091); the confirm variant documents its step as deliberately removed because read_state never extracts the fields (deep-research-confirm.yaml:1920).

Two of six nominated removal candidates are falsified as cuts: the divergent pivot is live (26 production import sites across 4 deep assets, 2 mode wrappers, reduce-state.cjs; introduced 1eb7ace51b 2026-07-11), and legacy projections plus the legacy watermark path are live (4559 LOC; append-mode-event.ts:676 emits legacy-projection run identities, check-projection-coverage.cjs has 8 refs, shadow-projection-store.ts writes .legacy-projection-watermarks/<artifactId>.json which check-direct-append.cjs enforces and deep-research-auto.yaml:2387 excludes from git add; introduced cbabd6bc4d 2026-07-21).

Two of this iteration's own scans produced false negatives that would have produced a wrong cut list: rg -rn 'legacy-projection-watermarks' printed '.n' because -r is ripgrep's replace flag, not recursive; and rg '...copilot...' | head -25 was truncated by trigger-index.json hits before reaching the deep assets, which the rg -o | uniq -c count scan then found (3 hits). Prefer rg -c counts over truncated head.
Six of seven if_cli_* kinds match a registered EXECUTOR_KIND; if_cli_copilot is the sole orphan, and a dsh-shim exists in the stress suite for a kind that is also not registered.
